description: The capability's card: purpose, use-when and do-not-use-when conditions, permissions, price, evidence summary, trust checks, links and a task-independent ak.offer.v1 offer. Use when: you can name a capability and want its facts, or want to check the conditions an evaluation asked about. Not for: an answer for your task (evaluate_capability) or the full benchmark records (get_benchmark). Input: a capability id, ak:// URI or slug, from a search, an evaluation or a page. Output: ak.capability.v1 with the card fields, parameters, versions, terms, evidence, trust and links.

capability.description: Capability id (ak:publisher:name or ak:publisher:name:x.y.z), ak:// URI or slug.

name: get_capability
title: Get a capability card
